headline: Fighting Rekindles at Fishermen's Row as Base Exchanges Mount
war_summary: Another edition goes to press with no decision rendered, and the fighting has found fresh addresses. Fishermen's Row, little noted in our last report, now draws the eye: four exchanges in the past two hours and fifteen within the day, the last logged as this dispatch is filed, leaving the Wardens six works, the Colonials two, and one post demolished between the lines. Linn Mercy outdid even that count with twenty-nine changes, nine of its eleven posts now Warden-held, while Endless Shore counted twenty-one, Brackish Point alone trading thirteen times, though its ledger still reads wholly Colonial. The Deadlands remain split six to five, their combined twenty-four-hour toll near thirty-three thousand and still climbing; the Weathered Expanse, though no post changed hands on record there, feeds the same grim arithmetic. Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle logged sharp exchanges as well, the latter now cooling, and Oarbreaker and Marban Hollow remain divided ground. Elsewhere, from Acrithia to the Umbral Wildwood, settled provinces record only light losses, yet fresh names swell every enlistment roll without pause.
